project_type: TF 2.10 groupwise 3D brain MRI registration (rigid/affine/deformable cascade over levels 4/2/1) + numpy/nibabel preprocessing package + SLURM/bash job scripts
language: Python 3.8 syntax (cluster container py3.8.10, TF 2.10, DALI 1.18, numpy 1.21.1, scipy 1.4.1, nibabel 3.1.1, matplotlib 3.5); bash for scripts
build_system: none (plain Python package layout at repo root: models/, data_loading/, runtime/, preprocessing/, inference/, scripts/, slurm/, tests/, tests/gpu/). Windows workspace, tests run in WSL Ubuntu conda envs.
test_framework: unittest for tests/ (every TF test module imports `from tests import tf_setup` FIRST); pytest for preprocessing/tests/ (run in bgr_preproc38)
build_command: py3.8 syntax check: bgr_preproc38 `python -m py_compile <files>` (tests/run_tests_wsl.sh stage 1 also does ast.parse(feature_version=(3, 8)))
test_command: Full: `wsl -d Ubuntu bash /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/tests/run_tests_wsl.sh` (~3 h, run in background, final integration only) and `wsl -d Ubuntu bash /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/preprocessing/tests/run_tests_wsl.sh bgr_preproc38 [pytest args]`. Targeted: write a script in .agents/tmp/<name>.sh and run `wsl -d Ubuntu bash -c "tr -d '\r' < /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad/.agents/tmp/<name>.sh | bash -s"`.
verification_instructions: tf_gpu script body: `cd /mnt/d/Research/Brain_Registration_Projects/brain-group-rad; source ~/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh; set +u; conda activate tf_gpu; export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=3 TF_CUDNN_WORKSPACE_LIMIT_IN_MB=512 BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=6000 TF_CUDNN_USE_AUTOTUNE=0; python -m unittest <names> -v`. bgr_preproc38 body: same with `conda activate bgr_preproc38` (no TF) for py_compile, TF-free unittests (tests.test_slurm_scripts, tests.test_sweep_tools, ...) and preprocessing pytest (`python -m pytest preprocessing/tests/<file> -q -p no:cacheprovider`, MPLBACKEND=Agg). Goldens: `tests.test_trainer.TestLinearOnlyUnchanged tests.test_trainer.TestDeformUnchanged` must report `[golden] max |diff| 0`. Cascade-skip guards: `tests.test_cascade.TestSkip tests.test_cascade.TestChainTrainer tests.test_cascade.TestStageSkipLevel2 tests.test_cascade.TestStageSkipChain`. Record every command and its result (counts, OK/FAIL, golden diffs) in .agents/tasks/synth-contrast/impl-log.md.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Golden fixtures tests/fixtures/m7_linear_golden.json and tests/fixtures/lncc_deform_golden.json must NOT be rewritten (never set BGR_WRITE_GOLDEN=1). No other generated files are checked in.
environment_constraints: NEVER set BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB / any TF GPU memory limit above 6000 MB locally (8 GB GTX 1080; 7000 crashed WSL). tf_gpu crashes if the GPU is hidden (do not set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=''). `set +u` before `conda activate`. Neither local env has nvidia.dali: DALI-dependent code must import and be unit-testable without DALI (pure-Python helpers), DALI tests skip. PowerShell 5.1 mangles quotes: put multi-line commands in .agents/tmp/*.sh (write the file FIRST, run it in a SEPARATE later call), see skill shell-and-remote-jobs. NO git commit, NO push, NO cluster job submission, NO ssh to the cluster in any step.
contribution_requirements: Design .agents/tasks/synth-contrast/design.md v4 is the source of truth (read sections 3-8, 11, 13.1, 13.1b); review.md NIT 1/2 and the orchestrator decisions OD1-OD6 in .agents/tasks/synth-contrast/plan.md are binding. Default off (--synth-prob 0) must build no new op / generator / DALI reader / checkpoint key / config record (goldens max |diff| 0). Python 3.8 only: no PEP 585/604 at runtime, no `dict |`, no str.removeprefix, no numpy > 1.21 APIs, no TF > 2.10 APIs, no new third-party dependency. Follow existing conventions: docstrings that state the design section, Python trace-time switches for opt-in features, `parser.error` for flag validation, atomic writes in the exporter. Append what you ran and the results to .agents/tasks/synth-contrast/impl-log.md.
key_patterns: Opt-in features are Python trace-time switches that build no op when off (e.g. `_intensity_aug_setup` returns (None, None); `if self.intensity_aug is not None:`). Separate seeded tf.random.Generator per stream (post-process seed + offset; `INTENSITY_AUG_SEED_OFFSET = 7919`) checkpointed via `Trainer.checkpoint_variables()` only when on. Per-image work in `tf.map_fn(..., parallel_iterations=1, fn_output_signature=...)`. Separable [n, n] axis operators applied with `tf_intensity_aug._apply_axis_matrix`. config.json extra records only for non-default runs (`main._optimizer_record` returns None by default). Resume guards in main.py (`_check_intensity_aug_device`: missing key = default). SLURM scripts: env with defaults, validators need_uint/need_float/need_choice/is_pos/die (exit 2), BGR_DRY_RUN=1 prints `MAIN:`/`CHECK:` and exits before any write; EXTRA_ARGS last in MAIN. Preprocessing SLURM wrappers call `"${RIC[@]}"` (preprocessing/run_in_container.sh), never `python -m preprocessing` directly. Trainer tests use tests.runtime_helpers (narrow_config / tiny_config, synthetic_group, write_fake_export) and runtime.fixed_data (FixedGroupSource, synthetic_deform_group, synthetic_label_phantom, to_dali_batch, to_deform_batch).
directory_structure: models/ (GroupRegLevelModel, layers, transforms, cascade FrozenStage/FrozenChain); data_loading/ (params TF-free constants, dali_loader DALI pipelines importable without DALI, data_module manifest + DALIDatasets, postprocess TF post-DALI processing, tf_intensity_aug); runtime/ (args CLI TF-free, run Trainer/TrainConfig, fixed_data synthetic groups + validation sets, checkpoint, losses, metrics); main.py training entry; preprocessing/ (export-npy exporter, luts, cli, slurm wrappers, pytest tests); tests/ (unittest; tests/gpu = cluster-only GPU checks and the run checker check_mixed_run.py); slurm/ (r_level{4,2,1}.sh training scripts, sweep_level4.py, verify_m.sh, ...); scripts/ (helpers); .agents/tasks/synth-contrast/ (design, review, plan, impl-log, impl-report, FEAT artifacts).
